title: Carn A'Choire Mhoir Whitley Memorial
memorial_type: Cairn with plaque at crash site

external_narratives.summary: IWM records the cairn memorial at the crash site of Whitley N1498 on Carn a Choire Mhoir, near Tomatin in the Highlands. The memorial commemorates personnel killed when the aircraft of 19 OTU crashed on 6 January 1942.
external_narratives.link_description: The poignant Whitley Memorial at Carn a'Choire Mhoir's crash site, honoring fallen crew members.

external_narratives.summary: Detailed crash site documentation of Whitley Mk.V N1498 from 19 OTU RAF Kinloss. The aircraft flew into high ground when descending through cloud during an evening training flight. Four crew were killed and three were injured. The pilot ignored the last bearing obtained before the crash.
key_details: Aircraft descended through cloud into high ground
external_narratives.link_description: Detailed documentation on Whitley Mk.V N1498 crash site at Carn A'Choire Mhoir Whitley Memorial.

external_narratives.summary: War Memorials Online records the Whitley N1498 air crash site memorial on Carn a Choire Mhoir. The rear turret of the aircraft was recovered by helicopter in 1976 and is now at the Midland Air Museum in Coventry.
key_details: Rear turret recovered by Sea King helicopter c.1976
Turret now at Midland Air Museum, Coventry

memorial_details:
Name: AW Whitley N1498
Type: Cairn
Description: Cairn erected near crash site with plaque attached.
Inscription: MEMORIAL: This plaque is in memory of/ those personnel killed when/ Whitley Mk V Aircraft/ operating with 19 OTU RAF Kinloss/ crashed here on 6th January 1942/ [crew names inscribed on memorial]
Location: Carn a' choire Mhoir approx 3 miles east of Tomatin Inverness Highlands and Islands IV13 7XY Scotland
Grid Ref: NH 843 291
Coordinates: 57.337694541450,-3.923759185315
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/46/470/large_6049.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/46/471/large_6049_2.jpg

Magoo's bothy restoration (2002): The nearby Magoo's bothy was restored in memory of Flight Lieutenant Mark James Maguire, lost in peacekeeping operations in Kosovo.

Cairn erection near crash site: A cairn was erected near the Whitley N1498 air crash site with a plaque attached.
